title: Optimistic concurrency conflict

checks.check: requested address with concurrent VIP update retained

final_response:
Done — verified at version 3.

- Initial read was version 1 (`vip: false`); the first patch with `expected_version: 1` returned `VERSION_CONFLICT` because a concurrent update had committed (`vip: true`, version 2).
- Re-fetched the record and reapplied only the requested change with `expected_version: 2`, so the concurrent `vip` value was preserved.

Final record C-7: `name: Lina`, `address: 42 Pine Street`, `vip: true`, version 3.
